summary: Iteration 2 (5 improvements) fully verified. Backend: 40/40 pytest tests PASSED (added 15 new tests in test_iteration2.py covering price edit + RBAC, HPP recompute, PO draft/receive + cash-out, /settings GET/PUT + owner-only, partial payment + ledger + adjust-receivable + RBAC, driver CRUD with vehicle/plate + self-delete guard + driver_id/name persistence on delivery txn). Also patched 2 pre-existing regression tests that broke due to iter-2 changes: (a) settle_transaction now requires PaymentIn body -> tests now pass {}; (b) Resto Sederhana deposit_balance is no longer 0 due to persistent DB state across runs -> test now uses qty=100 LPG 12Kg to guarantee overspend. Frontend (mobile 390x844): owner login OK, dashboard shows 4 new quick-actions (Kelola Kurir, Pengaturan, Katalog Harga, Setoran). Stok screen has 9 `edit-{id}` (Edit Harga) buttons opening modal with pf-name/pf-price-eceran/pf-price-warung/pf-price-pangkalan/pf-price-korporat fields; show-po-button opens draft-PO sheet with 'Terima Stok' (draft for Air Isi Ulang visible from backend tests). /settings screen renders opt-print/opt-whatsapp/opt-skip + save-settings-button and persists selection. /manage-users lists 5 karyawan, add-user-button opens modal with uf-name/uf-email/uf-vehicle/uf-plate (driver-specific fields). Pelanggan tab renders receivable/deposit/plafon columns.

issues: Plafon like 'Rp10.000.000' wraps awkwardly to a second line ('Rp10.000.00' / '0') in the narrow 3-column layout on 390px width. Consider shrinking font, using compact notation (Rp10jt), or adjusting numberOfLines / flex.

react_native_issues.issue: 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated. Use style.pointerEvents' and '"shadow*" style props are deprecated. Use "boxShadow"' warnings on many screens. Likely originate from react-native-web or 3rd-party libs (react-native-vector-icons / safe-area-context); check if any local StyleSheet uses shadowColor/shadowOffset/shadowOpacity/shadowRadius and migrate to boxShadow, and replace <View pointerEvents="..."> with style={{ pointerEvents: '...' }}.
'Animated: useNativeDriver is not supported...' logged from a Modal/Animated call on web. Consider useNativeDriver: false in web or wrap in Platform.OS check. Non-blocking on Expo Go / web preview.

action_items: (Optional) Address deprecated pointerEvents/shadow* warnings by migrating to style.pointerEvents / boxShadow to be future-proof for RN 0.75+.
(Optional) Compact Rupiah formatting on customer card so 8-digit plafon does not wrap ugly on 375-390px devices.
(Optional) Add cleanup of TEST_ prefixed customers/users at end of test session so Pelanggan list does not accumulate on repeated runs.

Still uses deprecated @app.on_event('startup'/'shutdown') - migrate to FastAPI lifespan (non-blocking today).
settle_transaction with amount<=0 returns 400 which is correct; frontend must send {} to full-settle (currently done in api.ts / pelanggan.tsx).
